children: Raymond James Financial reported record client assets under administration of $1.97 trillion and 30% year-over-year growth in financial assets under management.
Client assets under administration reached $1,966.4B, up 16% year-over-year and 2% sequentially, driven by markets and net inflows.
Financial assets under management were $350.5B, a 30% increase versus August 2025, and up 2% month-over-month.
Private Client Group AUA rose to $1,899.7B (17% YoY), with fee-based accounts at $1,181.2B (21% YoY).
Clients’ domestic cash sweep and Enhanced Savings balances totaled $57.4B, up 6% year-over-year and 1% from July.
Bank loans, net were $56.4B, up 12% year-over-year and essentially flat sequentially.
